title: 第21章 族学授课起风波第22章 整顿族学
slug: 穿越庶长兄嫡弟竟是仙帝转世
content_zh:
族学的执教长老慌忙从讲堂内奔出，几乎是踉跄着上前躬身行礼，声音微微发颤：“不知少君驾临，未能远迎，恳请少君恕罪！”
云煌只淡淡一摆手，径直走到仙台前方视野最佳，刚被迅速清理出来的主位安然落座，随后便阖上双眸，周身清贵疏离，对即将开始的课程好像并无半分兴趣。
云擎走到台前，玄衣墨发，身姿如孤松渊临。面对台下无数道好奇、崇拜、审视，乃至隐秘嫉妒的目光，他神色平静，从容不迫地开始了今日关于《基础灵力运转与实战微操》的讲解。
他声音清越如山间流泉，将晦涩复杂的灵力原理拆解得深入浅出，偶尔亲自下场演示招式，动作如行云流水，精准潇洒，引得台下的年轻子弟们目不转睛，心生向往，连呼吸都不自觉地放轻了。
“方才所讲，灵力运转核心在于‘意动气动，气动力生’，重在引导与控制，而非依靠蛮力驱使。”他目光扫过台下，最终落在一名因云煌在场显得格外局促不安的庶出少年身上，唇角勾起一抹令人如沐春风的温和笑意，“譬如……你，出列。运转基础引气诀，用你最强的招式，攻向我。”
那少年吓得一个激灵，运转体内灵力，颤巍巍地一拳挥出。
姿势歪斜，灵力涣散如沙。
云擎不闪不避，甚至未曾动用灵力，只是在那少年拳头即将及身的刹那，伸出两根修长的手指，在其手腕关节处看似随意地一拂、一引、一送。动作飘逸灵动如蝶栖花蕊。
那少年只觉一股无法抗拒却又异常温和醇厚的灵力瞬间涌入经脉，自身那原本涣散无序、四处乱窜的灵力，竟如同被一只无形玄妙的大手瞬间梳理归拢，不由自主地沿着某种契合天地韵律的轨迹急速凝聚、压缩，最终悍然汇于拳锋——
“呼！”
一道比方才凝练刚猛了数倍不止的纯白色气劲，如同离弦之箭般破空而出，发出清晰的撕裂声！
“看明白了？”云擎收回手，对着目瞪口呆的弟子们温和笑道，语气带着令人心折的从容与自信，“灵力如同江河之水，堵不如疏，疏不如引。关键在于找准流转的关窍与韵律，因势利导。四两拨千斤，这便是‘微操’之精髓所在，它并非追求极致强大的力量，而是教会你们如何更高效精准地用好体内每一分灵力。”
有这般立竿见影的神奇示范，台下子弟纷纷摩拳擦掌，跃跃欲试。
“诸位可互相切磋一试。”云擎顺势说道，场面顿时热烈起来。
他含笑看着这些朝气蓬勃、充满无限可能的身影，刚欲开口再行指点，日辉院西北角落处，却猛地传来一道灵力剧烈碰撞的闷响，伴随着几声压抑的惊呼和不屑的嗤笑。
众人循声望去，只见一名身着锦袍、神色倨傲的嫡系子弟，正以一道凌厉掌风，将对面一名玄衣少年逼得连连后退。
那少年脚步虚浮、脸色苍白，正是曾被云煌重罚、丹田受损至今未愈的云厉。他紧咬着牙关，嘴角渗出一缕刺目的鲜红，眼神却阴鸷不屈，顽强地挺直脊背。
“云厉，你这‘叠浪劲’软绵无力，破绽百出，看来上次受罚之后，你这丹田气海是彻底废了？真是丢尽我们日辉院的脸！那嫡系子弟脸上带着毫不掩饰的轻蔑，声调高扬：“不如早些滚去月耀…不，月耀院怕是都嫌你累赘，还是去云芽小筑和那些奶娃娃作伴吧！不过他们尚且丹田圆满，未来成就，恐怕都远在你这废物之上！”
他言语恶毒，招招直指云厉丹田旧伤之处，显然是刻意折辱，眼角余光更是时不时偷偷瞥向高台上阖眸静坐的云煌，带着毫不掩饰的讨好与卖弄之意。
周围不少子弟冷眼旁观，或面露讥诮，或敢怒不敢言。云厉平日因出身和性情的缘故，人缘并不算好，加之他之前触怒少君被重罚之事人尽皆知，寻常人更是不愿沾染。

之前被云擎点上台示范的那名庶出少年躲在云厉身后不远处，嘴唇嗫嚅了几下，似是想说些什么，挣扎片刻终是未曾开口。
云厉死死咬着下唇，拳头紧握，眼中充满屈辱不甘，却因体内灵力滞涩、丹田处隐隐作痛而无法反驳。
他之前被云煌神力所伤，丹田受创，虽非不治之症，但需要一种极罕见的“凝元固脉丹”方能根治。此丹炼制不易，药材难寻，加之他庶出身份又明显得罪过少家主，族中负责资源分配的长老和执事们，自然无人愿意为他这个“弃子”冒险出头，以致伤势拖延至今。
就在那嫡系子弟脸上狞笑更甚，周身灵力狂涌，准备彻底将云厉击溃，让其当众颜面扫地之时——
一道玄色身影，如清风般倏然介入两人之间。
云擎并未出手攻击，只是指尖随意一拂，一股磅礴的混沌灵力荡开，轻描淡写地将那嫡系子弟凌厉狠绝的掌风化解于无形。同时，一股柔韧的劲力稳稳托住踉跄欲倒的云厉。
“同族切磋，点到即止。恃强凌弱，攻人伤处，非君子所为，亦有违族学教诲。”云擎声音平和，却带着不容置疑的威严，重瞳幽光扫过那嫡系子弟，使其瞬间如坠冰窟，所有嚣张气焰冻结在脸上。
那嫡系子弟脸色由红转青，想辩解反驳，却在触及云擎重瞳的刹那，所有话都卡在了喉咙里，化作了一声讷讷的：“……是，大公子教训的是。”他本想讨好少君，却不想先得罪了这位明显更得少君“纵容”的大公子。
没想到云厉这个阴沉不讨喜的小子，竟然还和大公子有交情不成？
云擎见他如此，不由心下暗叹：上有所好，下必甚焉啊。
随即，他转向云厉，目光落在他苍白的脸色和紧捂丹田的手上。云厉接触到他的目光，下意识地偏头避开视线，带着几分难堪、戒备，还有一丝不易察觉的……自惭形秽。
云擎并未多言，翻手取出一个朴素的玉瓶，将之随手抛给云厉，语气温和平淡：“此乃‘固源复仙丹’，足以根治你丹田旧伤。拿去吧，好生修炼，莫要再因一时意气行差踏错，堕了自身志气风骨。”
当然，这并非云煌所赠的那盒灵气氤氲的“九转还玉丹”——开玩笑，若是拿那位祖宗亲手炼制，还蕴含其本源气息的丹药送人，以他那看似高冷淡漠实则“极度小心眼”的性子，指不定又要怎么折腾。云擎几乎能想象到那双淡金色眼瞳微眯，周遭温度骤降十度的场景。
不过，他给出的这“固源复仙丹”，品阶却比那“凝元固脉丹”高出不止一筹，更是对症下药。

content_en:
The teaching elder of the clan school hurriedly ran out of the lecture hall, almost staggering forward and bowed to salute, his voice trembling slightly: "I didn't know that the young master was coming, but I couldn't welcome you from far away. I beg you to forgive me!"
Yunhuang just waved his hand faintly and walked straight to the front of Sendai where he had the best view. He sat down safely at the main seat that had just been quickly cleared. Then he closed his eyes, looking noble and distant, and seemed not to be interested in the course that was about to begin.
Yun Qing walked to the stage, wearing black clothes and dark hair, and his posture was like a lonely pine tree approaching the abyss. Facing countless curious, admiring, scrutinizing, and even secretly jealous glances from the audience, he looked calm and calmly began today's explanation of "Basic Spiritual Power Operation and Practical Micro-Management".
His voice was as clear as a spring in the mountains, and he broke down the obscure and complex principles of spiritual power in a simple and easy-to-understand manner. He would occasionally demonstrate moves in person, and his movements were as smooth as flowing water, precise and unrestrained, attracting the attention of the young disciples in the audience, who were fascinated by him, and even breathed less unconsciously.
"As I just said, the core of spiritual power operation is 'the mind moves the air, and the air moves the force'. It focuses on guidance and control, rather than relying on brute force." His eyes swept the audience, and finally landed on a commoner boy who seemed particularly uncomfortable because of Yunhuang's presence. The corner of his lips evoked a gentle smile that made people feel like a spring breeze. "For example...you, come out. Use the basic air-entraining technique to attack me with your strongest move."
The young man was so frightened that he moved his spiritual power and punched out with a trembling fist.
The posture is crooked and the spiritual power is as scattered as sand.
Yun Qing did not dodge or even use his spiritual power. At the moment when the young man's fist was about to reach his body, he stretched out two slender fingers and flicked, guided and sent them seemingly casually at the wrist joints. The movements are elegant and agile, like a butterfly perched on a flower.
The young man felt an irresistible but extremely gentle and mellow spiritual energy pouring into his meridians instantly. His spiritual energy, which was originally scattered and chaotic, seemed to be instantly sorted out and gathered together by an invisible and mysterious hand. It involuntarily condensed and compressed rapidly along some trajectory that conformed to the rhythm of heaven and earth, and finally converged at the front of his fist——
"Phew!"
A pure white energy that was several times stronger than the one just condensed shot out of the air like an arrow from a string, making a clear tearing sound!
"Understood?" Yun Qing took back his hand and smiled gently at the stunned disciples, with a heart-wrenching calmness and confidence in his tone, "Spiritual power is like the water of a river. It is better to block it than to dredge it, and to divert it better than to divert it. The key is to find the key point and rhythm of the circulation, and make the best use of the situation. To move a thousand pounds four or two, this is the essence of 'micro-management'. It does not pursue the ultimate power, but teaches you how to use every ounce of spiritual power in your body more efficiently and accurately."
With such a miraculous demonstration of immediate results, the children in the audience were eager to give it a try.
"You all can try to learn from each other." Yun Qing said smoothly, and the scene suddenly became lively.
He looked at these energetic figures full of infinite possibilities with a smile, and was about to speak before giving some advice when a muffled sound of violent collision of spiritual powers suddenly came from the northwest corner of the Rihui Courtyard, accompanied by several suppressed exclamations and disdainful sneers.
Everyone looked around and saw a direct descendant wearing a brocade robe and an arrogant expression, using a fierce palm wind to force a young man in black clothes opposite him to retreat.
The young man's steps were sloppy and his face was pale. He was Yun Li who had been severely punished by Yun Huang and whose Dantian was damaged and has not recovered yet. He clenched his teeth, a dazzling bright red oozed from the corner of his mouth, his eyes were sinister and unyielding, and he straightened his back tenaciously.
"Yun Li, your 'Die Lang Jin' is weak and full of flaws. It seems that after the last punishment, your Dantian Qihai has been completely destroyed? It really brings shame to our Rihui Academy! The direct disciple had undisguised contempt on his face and said in a high voice: "Why don't you go to Yueyao as soon as possible... No, Yueyao Academy may think you are a burden, so go to Yunya Xiaozhu and those other people.Let’s have a milk doll as a companion! However, they still have perfect dantian, and their future achievements will probably be far above that of trash like you! "
His words were vicious, and his moves were directed at the old wounds in Yunli's dantian. It was obvious that he was deliberately humiliating him. From the corner of his eye, he occasionally glanced at Yunhuang, who was sitting quietly on the high platform with his eyes closed, with an unabashed intention to please and show off.
Many of the disciples around looked on with cold eyes, some looked sarcastic, some dared to be angry but dared not speak. Due to his background and temperament, Yun Li was not very popular. In addition, everyone knew that he had offended Shao Jun and was severely punished, and ordinary people were even more reluctant to get involved.
The young concubine whom Yun Qing had previously asked to come on stage to demonstrate was hiding not far behind Yun Li. He muttered his lips a few times, as if he wanted to say something, but after struggling for a moment, he finally did not speak.
Yun Li bit his lower lip and clenched his fists. His eyes were full of humiliation and unwillingness, but he could not refute due to the stagnant spiritual energy in his body and the dull pain in his Dantian.
He had been injured by Yunhuang's divine power before, and his Dantian was injured. Although it was not an incurable disease, it required an extremely rare "Yuan-Coagulating Pulse Pill" to cure it. It is difficult to refine this elixir, and it is difficult to find medicinal materials. In addition, he is a commoner and has clearly offended the young family head. Naturally, no one among the elders and deacons responsible for resource allocation in the clan is willing to take risks for this "abandoned son", so the injury has been delayed to this day.
Just when the face of the direct descendant became even more ferocious, and the spiritual power surged around his body, he was ready to completely defeat Yun Li and make him lose face in public——
A black figure suddenly intervened between the two of them like a breeze.
Yun Qing did not attack, but with a casual flick of his fingertips, a majestic chaotic spiritual power spread out, easily dispelling the fierce and ruthless palm wind of the direct descendant. At the same time, a flexible force steadily supported the staggering Yun Li.
“Competition among fellow clansmen ends at the last minute. Bullying the weak by relying on strength and attacking others' wounds is not the behavior of a gentleman, and it also goes against the teachings of the clan. "Yun Qing's voice was calm, but with unquestionable majesty. His heavy eyes swept over the direct descendant, making him feel like he had fallen into an ice cave, and all his arrogance was frozen on his face.
The direct descendant's face turned from red to blue, and he wanted to defend and refute, but the moment he touched Yun Qing's heavy eyes, all his words were stuck in his throat and turned into a dull voice: "...Yes, that's what the eldest son taught me. " He originally wanted to please Shaojun, but he didn't want to offend the young master who was obviously more "connived" by Shaojun.
I didn’t expect that Yun Li, a gloomy and unpleasant boy, would actually be friends with the eldest son?
Seeing him like this, Yun Qing couldn't help but secretly sigh: What is good at the top will be very bad at the bottom.
Immediately, he turned to Yun Li, his eyes falling on his pale face and the hand covering his dantian. Yun Li caught his gaze and subconsciously turned his head to avoid sight, with a bit of embarrassment, wariness, and a hint of imperceptible... self-consciousness.
Yun Qing didn't say much. He took out a simple jade bottle and threw it to Yun Li. His words were gentle and calm: "This is the 'Guyuan Restoration Pill', which is enough to cure the old wounds in your Dantian. Take it, have a good time practicing, and don't let your ambition and character fall due to a temporary misstep. "
Of course, this is not the box of spiritual energy-filled "Nine Turns of Jade Return Pill" that Yunhuang gave - just kidding, if he were to give away the pill that was refined by his ancestors and still contained his original aura, he might be in trouble with his seemingly cold and indifferent temperament but actually "extremely petty". Yun Qing could almost imagine the scene where those pale golden eyes narrowed slightly and the surrounding temperature dropped ten degrees.
However, the "Source-Restoring Immortal Pill" he gave was much higher in grade than the "Yuan-Condensing Pulse Pill", and it was the right medicine for the situation.
